info.title: FazerCards Public API
info.description: HTTPS JSON endpoints under **`/api/v2`** using your reseller API key. Send the key as **`X-API-Key: fc_…`** or **`Authorization: Bearer fc_…`** unless an operation explicitly says otherwise. Most responses wrap data in `{ ok, … }`. Website signup / partner-account routes are not listed here.

post.description: Create a Steam wallet top-up order. Your USD balance is charged immediately according to your plan and the rates from `GET /steam-topup/rates`. `USD`: `amount` at most **2 decimal places** (cents); `RUB/UAH/KZT`: **up to 4** — billed USD nominal is rounded **up** to the next cent so the refill is not below what you typed; stored `amountLocal` reflects the nominal’s local estimate. The response returns the created order; final status may change while processing.

amount.description: If `currency` is USD: **at most 2** fractional digits (`5`, `"5.01"` — not `"5.999"`). Otherwise up to **4** decimals.

**Idempotency (optional):** send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string, ≤255 chars) to make retries safe — repeating the same request with the same key returns the original order instead of charging/fulfilling again. Omit the header for the previous behavior.

post.description:
Place a top-up order. **`category_id`** and **`offer_id`** must both match one row from `GET /topups/offers?category_id=…` (same `category_id` as in the topups list; `offer_id` = `offer_id` on the offer; many categories may reuse the same `offer_id` string — the pair is unique). `fields` — `{ [key]: value }`; for `select` use listed `options`. Balance is charged immediately; then `processing` until completed/refund.

**Idempotency (optional):** send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string, ≤255 chars) to make retries safe — repeating the same request with the same key returns the original order instead of charging/fulfilling again. Omit the header for the previous behavior.

Returns whether the ID is valid, the player name and (when the game provides it) the region. A `422` means the ID could not be confirmed — ask the buyer to contact support.
